mstts:express-as.prosody: Ever wonder why some people seem to have a knack for seeing what's coming next—while the rest of us are left guessing? Welcome to a journey where uncertainty isn't something to be feared, but explored and understood. We're about to dive into the fascinating world that Philip E. Tetlock uncovers in his book, Superforecasting: The Art and Science of Prediction. Together, we'll uncover how forecasting isn't just for so-called experts—it's a skill anyone can build, blending both art and science. Imagine being able to break down tough questions, shift your thinking when the facts change, and actually learn from every wrong turn you take. Superforecasters do just that. They're not magical, but what sets them apart is their relentless curiosity, open minds, and the courage to update their beliefs without clinging to ego. As we dig deeper, you'll see how the habits of these extraordinary predictors—like embracing uncertainty, thinking in probabilities, and working together—can help all of us make sense of the unknown. So, let’s explore how intellectual honesty and practical wisdom can turn the future from a mystery into something we can actually wrap our heads around. Ready? Let’s get started—together.
